item: 6-1457 gh1-100 #133 — 두 풀이를 '혹은' 으로 이은 낱말 메모 → 한 문장 문제(수정안 그대로)
6-1461 gh1-102 #144 — 확신 부사를 넣은 예/아니오 의문문은 앞뒤가 안 맞음 → 평서문(한국어)

text.from: 미국이 의심의 여지없이 미래의 테러 위협에 직면할까?
text.to: 미국은 의심의 여지없이 미래의 테러 위협에 직면할 것이다.

item: 6-1461 gh1-103 #144 — 평서문(영어 모범 답안 · 대체 답안)

text.from: Will the United States undoubtedly face future terrorist threats?
text.to: The United States will undoubtedly face future terrorist threats.

from: Will the United States without a doubt face future terrorist threats?
Will the U.S. undoubtedly face future terrorist threats?
Will America undoubtedly face future terrorist threats?
to: The United States will without a doubt face future terrorist threats.
The U.S. will undoubtedly face future terrorist threats.
America will undoubtedly face future terrorist threats.

right: The US will undoubtedly face future terrorist threats.
wrong: Will the United States undoubtedly face future terrorist threats?
The United States will undoubtedly face future economic threats.

item: 6-1462 gh1-102 #145 — 군대 = army · troops · 어색한 대체 답안 'defeat enemies'(한 번의 일에 관사 없는 복수) 뺌

from: When did our forces defeat their enemies?
When did our forces defeat enemies?
to: When did our forces defeat their enemies?
When did our army defeat the enemy?
When did our troops defeat the enemy?

right: When did our army defeat the enemy?
When did our troops defeat the enemy?
wrong: When did our forces defeat enemies?
When did our army attack the enemy?
